svg.title: Few-shot adaptation of the idiosyncratic head
svg.desc: The fixed RABBiT encoder feeds a blue shared coefficient head and an orange idiosyncratic coefficient head. Each multiplies its fixed cortical basis; the two responses sum to the predicted fMRI. A few minutes of paired audio and fMRI from a new subject tune only the idiosyncratic coefficient head. Cortical illustrations are reused unchanged from the paper's methods figure. The small parameter annotation follows the current manuscript's approximately 115 thousand versus 222 million fitted parameters.
svg.text: ~115K fitted parameters — ≈2,000× fewer than voxel-wise ridge
